Notable Accomplishments

Well-known author of non-fictional books, New York Times bestselling author, published 12 books in 19 years

Best known for his first non-fiction work, Bringing Down the House; its story was made into the movie 21 (2008)

Named to Hollywood's 25 most powerful authors list

Host of TV shows: High Stakes with Ben Mezrich, The World Series of Blackjack for GSN, and The Filthy Rich Guide for CNBC

Speaks across the world to groups and schools about his adventures and the narrative non-fiction genre of writing

Outstanding Taiwanese American elected by T.A. Archives in 03/2019

Publications: Charlie Numbers and the Woolly Mammoth (2019), Charlie Numbers and the Man in the Moon (2017), Bringing Down the Mouse (2015), The Accidental Billionaires (2010)

Ben Mezrich, Author and writer at The Edinburgh International Book Festival 2011. His last book was adapted to become The Social Network, one of the most successful movies of 2010. Now, Mezrich has turned his attention to another strange-but-true American tale in his novel Sex on the Moon. Back in 2002, a gifted former NASA intern and his girlfriend set out to steal a safe containing moon rocks from every Apollo mission. In this event he explains how he reimagined the story of a real life heist
